title: fix(devx): reseed two hand-rolled repo-root walks to the recognised findUp spelling
body:
Fixes #18871

Clause-②: no

Executes the maintainer ruling on this card — batch #165 item 5, letter **B**, 「同意」 2026-09-18T14:38Z (issue comment 5731591525). ⛔ No recogniser change and no `AGENTS.md` edit: letter A was rejected as a governed surface and as gate development the maintainer has closed.

## What was wrong

`check:cross-package-test-inputs` recognises a repo-root seed by its **spelling**, not by its behaviour. Two tests walked up to `pnpm-workspace.yaml` with a hand-rolled `for (;;)` loop — one behind a named `repoRoot()` helper, one behind an IIFE — so the walk resolved to nothing in the collector, every read built on it resolved to nothing too, and both files produced **zero escapes**. The gate was green over two real cross-package reads:

| file | what it really reads | before |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/live-dialect-matrix.budget.test.ts` | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — the live job's `--stall-minutes N`, which is the ceiling half of the live-cell budget's derivation | absent from `--list-escapes`, and the input was undeclared |
| `packages/plugins/organizations/src/open-only-wall-acceptance.test.ts` | every workspace `package.json`, walking the open composition's transitive closure | absent from `--list-escapes`; its radius was covered only because a sibling in the same package declares `packages/**/package.json` for its own reasons — correct by coincidence |

## What changed

1. **Both tests spell the seed `findUp`**, copied from the recognised holder `no-framework-dependents.pin.test.ts`. Each carries a short docblock saying why the spelling is load-bearing.
2. **Both radii are declared, the way the declared siblings declare theirs.** `@objectstack/driver-sql` gains the glob `.github/workflows/ci.yml` in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`, mirrored into `turbo.json` as `$TURBO_ROOT$/.github/workflows/ci.yml` so the cache hash moves with it. The organizations entry gains `open-only-wall-acceptance.test.ts` as a second `heldBy` witness on `packages/**/package.json`, so that glob is now held by that file **in its own right** rather than inherited from its sibling.
3. **The collector's header gains one sentence** (`scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`, end of the ANCHOR-seed section): an anchor is recognised by spelling and not by behaviour, a hand-rolled root walk resolves to nothing, seed with `findUp`. It points at this card, where the class stays on record: a third hand-rolled instance is the evidence for widening the recogniser.
4. **Two prose citations of whole repo-relative paths were shortened to bare file names.** Making these files escaping puts their comments on the flat literal collector's roster, and a citation is not a read — the same trap `#9763` records in the collector's header.

⭐ The class record is deliberately **not** erased. The earlier measurement round on this card counted five hand-rolled walks (two live — both fixed here — one outside the gate's remit, two latent). That count is the evidence for reopening letter A, and it stays on the card.

## The hard post-condition, with its controls

`node scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs --list-escapes`, exit 0 both times. The controls are read in the **same** run as the new lines, because two lines appearing while the controls vanish is a broken instrument and not a pass:

| file | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `live-dialect-matrix.budget.test.ts` | 0 | **1** |
| `open-only-wall-acceptance.test.ts` | 0 | **1** |
| `live-dialect-matrix.isolation.test.ts` (control) | 1 | 1 |
| `no-framework-dependents.pin.test.ts` (control) | 1 | 1 |

Dump length 168 lines → 170 lines, and `diff` of the two dumps is exactly the two added lines — nothing else in the roster moved.

`pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs`: exit **0** before, exit **0** after. Roster line both times:

```
OK: 29 package(s) read outside themselves, all declared, and turbo.json hashes every declared glob (6 of them on a split "test:repo" task); 13 walked root(s) judged, 3 on ACCEPTED_WALK_RADII; 2027 test file(s) import a workspace sibling by bare specifier over 349 package pair(s), every one declared.
```

An intermediate reading worth recording: with the reseed in and the declarations **not** yet written, the gate went **red** naming `.github/workflows/ci.yml` under `@objectstack/driver-sql` — so the declaration this PR adds is one the gate demanded, not one asserted.

## Verification

- Both touched tests, run directly: `@objectstack/driver-sql src/live-dialect-matrix.budget.test.ts` — 6 passed; `@objectstack/organizations src/open-only-wall-acceptance.test.ts` — 32 passed.
- `node scripts/check-published-list-mirrors.mjs` — exit 0; `RECOGNISED_PATH_SPELLINGS` is byte-identical to its `AGENTS.md` block, untouched by this PR.
- Gate families derived in-worktree with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` and run; exits are in the dev report on the card. ⛔ By the tool's own warning this is not a complete account of CI.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/live-dialect-matrix.testkit.ts` and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/migrations/live-mysql-database.testkit.ts` carry the same hand-rolled walk, but use it only to reduce an absolute path to a repo-relative label, so no read escapes through it today. They are invisible for a second, independent reason as well: a `*.testkit.ts` is not a `*.test.*` file, so the collector's own file walk never scans it. Noted, not filed — latent, not a defect.
- `packages/runtime/src/cascade-delete-multivalue-lookup-real-driver.integration.test.ts` and `packages/types/src/node-isolation.test.ts` are the other two latent hand-rolled walks from the measurement round. Same reasoning: no escaping read goes through the walk today.
